growth.mode.firstLast.label: First → last
growth.mode.firstLast.note: Compares the first and the newest hunt of each group — what the tab always showed, and the most sensitive to one lucky or one bad hunt.
growth.mode.edgeMedians.label: First 3 vs last 3
growth.mode.edgeMedians.note: Compares the first and last hunts of each group by median (up to three each, never the same hunt twice), so one outlier at either end is far less decisive than in first → last.
growth.mode.trend.label: Trend fit
growth.mode.trend.note: Fits a straight line through every hunt in the group and reports the change across its span — uses all the evidence instead of two endpoints.
